ITA-1.9.3.2.10 vaśī वशी
Complete self-control
Absolute autonomy, not subject to control by others.

vasā वसा
Intramuscular fat
Supportive structural component of muscle.

ITA-5.41.26 vasāmehaḥ वसामेहः
Polyuria disorder with urine resembling muscle fat
A disorder characterized by recurrent passage of urine; passage of urine having a fatty appearance; passage of fat-mixed urine.

vastikukṣiḥ वस्तिकुक्षिः
Lumen of urinary bladder

vastimukham वस्तिमुखम्
Opening of the urinary bladder

vastiśiraḥ, vastimūrdhā, bastiśīrṣam वस्तिशिरः, वस्तिमूर्धा, बस्तिशीर्शम्
Bladder fundus

vāsanam वासनम्
Infusing or perfuming
A type of food processing which involves transferring properties by keeping food items in contact with another substance.
